Our approach blends top-tier technology with exceptional talent to optimize the monetization of digital screens in the physical world for our networks. As programmatic experts, we provide a streamlined experience through a single access point, offering expansive reach through our extensive coverage and delivering comprehensive support alongside strategic collaboration.
We are seeking a seasoned and motivated product manager with an understanding of the programmatic adtech ecosystem and a collaborative approach to product development. The candidate must be able to translate complex technical concepts into user-friendly solutions and produce compelling prototypes for those same solutions. This role is critical to driving Screenverse's evolution into a technology-driven company while delivering value to our media owner and buyer partners.

About Ballpark
At Ballpark, we're simplifying user research in a big way.
Since launching, we've grown from an ambitious startup into a platform trusted by teams at companies including Monzo, Vodafone, Sky, Shopify and Nord Security. As AI reshapes how software is built, we're seeing an increasing number of teams turn to Ballpark to validate ideas faster than ever before.
It's an exciting time to join. Product adoption is accelerating, our enterprise customer base continues to grow, and it couldn't be more important to spread awareness of what we're building and continue driving that growth.

s.h: We're looking for a Business Development Lead.
s.t:
This is a role for someone who loves generating pipeline but also enjoys figuring out better ways to generate it.
You'll spend much of your time building relationships with prospective customers and creating opportunities for our Account Executives. But unlike a traditional BDR role, you'll also own the evolution of our outbound motion.
You'll experiment with AI-powered prospecting workflows, evaluate new tools, improve our messaging, optimise our processes and help define what modern outbound looks like at Ballpark.
You'll have a genuine opportunity to influence how we generate revenue as we continue to scale.

Generate qualified pipeline through thoughtful outbound across email, LinkedIn, phone and any other channels that create meaningful conversations
Own prospecting strategy across target accounts, personas and industries
Design and continuously improve AI-assisted outbound workflows to help us scale intelligently
Evaluate new sales and AI tooling that gives Ballpark a competitive advantage
Refine messaging, sequences and outreach playbooks through constant experimentation
Share learnings across the team and help build the outbound playbook for future hires
Stay ahead of emerging AI and GTM trends, bringing new ideas back into the business

Previous outbound SaaS business development experience
A consistent track record of generating high-quality pipeline
Someone who enjoys building systems and improving processes, not just following them
Genuine curiosity around AI and excitement about applying new technology to sales
Strong written communication and an ability to personalise outreach at scale
Highly organised, proactive and commercially minded
Collaborative, humble and happy to share what's working with the wider team

Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played video game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.
We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.
That's where you come in.
The Riot Commercial Partnerships (RCP) team is responsible for identifying, building, and executing world-class partnerships with leading global and regional brands. Our mission is to drive revenue through strategic commercial collaborations that bring meaningful value to Riot’s fans - across Games, Entertainment, Esports, and Social Impact. For every product and event Riot creates, our premier partners help elevate the experience for millions of players and live audiences.
As an APAC Esports Partnership Manager, you will be a vital member of the APAC RCP team, helping drive the processes and procedures utilized to deliver for media rights partners and sponsors. In this role, you will be involved in all aspects of media rights partnership/sponsorship management, including licensing and contract management, broadcast and technical operations, partnership activation and integration, and data analytics and strategy.

Lead alignment across internal cross-functional teams and external partners through proactive communication to drive collaborative success.
Design and execute end-to-end operational workflows to ensure efficient and high-quality delivery of value to partners.
Develop and execute win-win strategies and actionable plans that deliver value to media partners and sponsors through esports services, while driving long-term fan satisfaction.
Conduct in-depth analysis of data to evaluate partnership performance and develop long-term strategies to maximize the value of Riot Esports partnerships.

4+ years of experience in partnership management, business development, account management or consulting
Self-starter with the eagerness and ability to handle multiple projects, prioritize work assignments, meet deadlines and work independently/collaboratively in a fast-paced environment
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders, both internally and externally.
Strong analytical skills and background, with demonstrated ability to use data to power decision making.
Fluency in Korean and a professional working proficiency in English.

Deep understanding of and empathy for gaming and esports fans, with the ability to view products and services through a fan-centric lens.
Experience working within the esports, traditional sports, entertainment, or media agency industries.
Familiarity with media rights, broadcast production operations, or digital streaming platforms.

Business Development and Communications Associate Department: New Business Position Summary: We are seeking a dynamic and highly motivated New Business Communications Specialist to help with the execution of our agency's new business and communication efforts.

The ideal candidate is a versatile "doer" who is excited to wear multiple hats, from designing marketing collateral and writing compelling copy to managing our content pipeline and supporting new business initiatives. This role is perfect for a tech-savvy, proactive individual who is an exceptional communicator and a quick learner.

We are looking for someone who is creative and who will bring life and new ideas to our agency's new business and marketing efforts. You will be encouraged to support our strategy, experiment with new tactics, and play a critical role in shaping our brand presence and driving our growth.

Key Responsibilities New Business Support: Will work closely with leadership to identify new market opportunities, assist in creating sales materials and partnership communications with prospective and current clients. Support the agency's new business campaigns and other active agency marketing and advertising efforts.

Support the new business team by preparing compelling proposals, graphics, and other sales enablement materials to help us win new clients. Be a Primary Contact for Agency Partnerships Help create content and materials to support joint marketing efforts with our important technology partners.

Will be a main point of contact for the agency partnerships by handling communication, marketing collateral and events, in collaboration with agency leadership.

Content Creation (Design & Copy): Design and produce a wide range of marketing materials, including social media graphics, case studies, one-pagers, and presentation decks using tools like Figma and/or Canva. Write clear, persuasive, and on-brand copy for our website, landing pages, case studies, email marketing campaigns, and other digital assets.

Project & Content Management: Own and manage our content and communications calendar, ensuring a steady stream of high-quality content. Lead the process of collecting information, assets, and written contributions from various team members, ensuring deadlines are met.

Social Media Management: Manage our agency's social media presence across key channels (e.g., LinkedIn, Instagram, X), including content scheduling, posting, and community engagement. Skills & Qualifications: Proven experience in a communications role at a digital agency or a similarly fast-paced, client-focused environment.

Exceptional writing, editing, and proofreading skills with a portfolio of writing samples (e.g., blog posts, web copy, email campaigns). Demonstrable graphic design skills with proficiency in a design tool like Figma, Canva, or the Adobe Creative Suite.

Excellent organizational and project management skills, with a keen eye for detail and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. A tech-savvy mindset and the ability to learn new software and platforms quickly. You should be very comfortable leveraging AI to complete tasks and projects.

Proficiency with Google Workspace (G Suite), including Docs, Sheets, and Slides. Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with different personalities and teams. A proactive, resourceful, and self-motivated attitude.

Position Summary: EASI is BoxPower 's cloud platform for modeling, pricing, and designing solar + storage microgrid projects — turning work that took weeks into minutes. Since its public beta launch in March 2026, external users have modeled $100M+ in project value on the platform.

EASI has strong top-of-funnel growth; this role's job is to turn users into active, successful users — and channel partners into a repeatable pipeline.

The Product & Business Development Associate is the face of EASI to developers, ESCOs, and utility partners: onboarding them, teaching them what's possible, publishing content that shows how, and demoing the platform at industry events.

Internally, they translate what they hear into roadmap input and go-to-market plans alongside the Director of Software Products. This is a high-ownership role for an early-career energy generalist who can hold their own in both a technical modeling conversation and a partner pitch. Roughly 75% business development and growth, 25% product management.

Key Responsibilities: Business development & partner enablement (~40%) Own onboarding and ongoing support for EASI channel partners (ESCOs, developers, EPCs, co-ops) — from NDA to first modeled project to portfolio adoption.

Run product demos: live at conferences and meetups, and scheduled deep-dives with prospective partners; drive on-the-spot signups. Support the sales team in using EASI for their own deals (proposals, budgetary pricing, RFP inputs). Gather structured partner feedback and verify partner-modeled projects as real commercial pipeline.

User engagement & growth (~35%) Own activation and retention of the existing user base: guided first-project onboarding, re-engagement campaigns, and targeted newsletters.

Create technical content — case studies and “how to model X in EASI” walkthroughs (resiliency, bridging power, flexible interconnection) — for LinkedIn, Reddit developer communities, and the blog. Run outbound experiments (cold email/calls to target segments) and identify high-fit events for demos.

Monitor product analytics (MixPanel) to spot stuck users, feature gaps, and conversion candidates. Product management (~25%) Turn user research and partner feedback into clear product requirements and prioritized roadmap input. Drive go-to-market for new EASI features: release messaging, documentation, training material, and demo scripts.

Maintain competitive awareness of adjacent modeling tools (HOMER, Xendee, Energy Toolbase, etc.) and how EASI wins.

Required Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in an energy-related field — electrical/mechanical engineering, physics, energy systems, or similar (or equivalent experience). 0–3 years of post-grad experience in energy, cleantech, consulting, or B2B software. Strong recent graduates are encouraged to apply.

Hands-on exposure to energy modeling tools — e.g. HOMER, Energy Toolbase, Xendee, PVsyst, HelioScope, or REopt — from coursework, research, or work. Excellent communicator — able to explain a techno-economic model to an engineer and its business value to an executive, in writing and live.

Self-directed operator — comfortable owning a number (activation, partner signups) and figuring out how to move it in a startup environment. Able to travel up to 25% for conferences, partner demos, and team onsites.

Preferred Qualifications: Understanding of microgrids, DERs, solar + storage economics, or utility planning and interconnection processes. Experience with CRM tools (HubSpot), product analytics (MixPanel), or content creation for technical audiences. Prior demo, sales engineering, applications engineering, or customer success exposure.

Experience selling to or working with utilities, co-ops, ESCOs, or EPCs. Based in California — Northern California or a West Coast hub is ideal for partner visits and events. Salary: $75,000 - $95,000 Originally posted on Himalayas

Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

Join our Partnerships Management team, the group responsible for some of Raisin’s most important strategic relationships. In this role, you’ll work directly with senior stakeholders at banks, helping them succeed on our platform and shaping long-term collaboration.

In addition, you will contribute to key projects - from launching new savings products on the marketplace to supporting technical bank migrations and much more. Because our impact and stakeholder network are broad, we maintain a unique view of priorities and upcoming changes. Colleagues across the business rely on our team to communicate these changes clearly and explain their impact.

·
Own and grow partnerships: Build strong, day-to-day relationships with our partner banks, ensuring smooth collaboration and shared success - enabled by in-person meetings.

·
Understand and enable: Develop a deep understanding of each banks’ requirements and align them with Raisin’s platform, working closely with our marketing and distribution teams to and out bank partners to unlock growth.

·
Drive impact across projects: Contribute to special initiatives — from launching new savings products to supporting strategic rollouts — and play an active role in shaping how we deliver value.

·
Collaborate globally: Work with colleagues across different markets and teams on key projects, bringing structure and clarity to complex challenges.

·
Create transparency: Track and report on partnership progress and project outcomes, ensuring internal stakeholders are aligned and informed.

·
Ensure operational excellence: Keep product information and documentation accurate and up to date, making sure our systems run seamlessly.

Your Profile

·
4+ years of experience in consulting, banking, or financial services, with a proven ability to manage senior stakeholders.

·
Excellent English and German communication skills, with the ability to influence at executive level.

·
Strong academic background in business, finance, economics, or similar.

·
Structured problem-solving and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-expectation environment.

·
A growth mindset and willingness to be hands-on where needed.

Partner aktivieren. Ein unterschriebener Partner, der nichts empfiehlt, ist kein Partner. Du sorgst dafür, dass aus Zusagen Umsatz wird.

Our ambition is to make Everlywell the go‑to commercialization and clinical operations partner for advanced diagnostics—helping innovators bring new tests to market, integrate telehealth and clinical services, and scale high‑quality programs across thousands of patients and multiple channels.

We are hiring a VP, Sales & Business Development – Diagnostic & Telehealth Services (DxS) to lead the B2B2C commercial motion for Everlywell ’s diagnostics services portfolio.
You will build and manage a proactive pipeline of consumer‑facing diagnostics brands, DTC digital-health companies, genetics companies with a consumer offering, virtual care providers, and innovative labs that can leverage Everlywell ’s infrastructure to launch and scale diagnostics‑driven programs.

You will own the full DxS sales lifecycle—from prospecting and discovery through solution design, commercial modeling, contracting, and handoff to implementation—while partnering closely with Clinical Operations, Product, Finance, and Marketing to shape offerings and ensure programs are set up to scale. Own the DxS B2B2C new‑business pipeline for diagnostics, genetics, and enterprise programs—from prospecting and qualification through proposal, negotiation, and close.

Serve as the voice of the market for DxS, feeding structured insights back into product, pricing, and go‑to‑market strategy for telehealth and digital health use cases.

5-10 years in enterprise sales or business development in telehealth, digital health, consumer diagnostics, or adjacent health tech, with a strong track record of closing complex, multi‑stakeholder deals.
Direct experience selling B2B2C or platform programs through partners (e.g., telehealth platforms, virtual primary care, digital health brands, employers, payers, retailers)—not just hospital/IDN lab contracts.

We now run four summits, across four continents, in four quarters. Each event brings together the most important voices in MedTech and HealthTech to move the industry forward, and we are growing fast.

This is a senior, hands-on role built for someone who has the experience to operate independently and the instinct to collaborate. You will not be managing a large team from day one. You will be generating pipeline, closing sponsors and partners, and setting the commercial standard for the region.

Drive revenue across MedTech World's sponsorship, exhibition, and partnership offerings for the UK and European markets, covering all four annual summits.

Represent MedTech World at industry events, conferences, and networking forums across Europe to build brand presence and generate leads.
Work closely with the partnerships and marketing teams to ensure a seamless experience for sponsors and partners before, during, and after each event.
Provide regular pipeline reports, revenue forecasts, and market intelligence to the leadership team.
Identify and pursue new commercial opportunities across the European region, including government bodies, trade associations, accelerators, and innovation hubs.

Remote. Open to candidates across the UK and Europe, provided they are eligible to work in their country of residence. Relocation to our Malta HQ is also welcomed and supported.

Proven track record in senior sales or business development within the events, MedTech, HealthTech, or life sciences sectors.
A strong existing network across European MedTech, HealthTech, or healthcare innovation that you can activate from day one.
The ability to work independently without day-to-day direction, while remaining a strong and collaborative team player.
Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and closing high-value commercial agreements.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills.

As the market leader globally, our products are shopper-centric, frictionless, and create memorable commerce experiences. Our products provide a competitive edge through experiences that improve brand trust, amplify product differentiation and assortments, increase conversion rate, improve profit margins, and speed time to market.
Learn how the world’s largest brands, including Mars, L'Oreal, Coca-Cola, Bosch, and GSK, as well as retailers and distributors such as E.Leclerc, Carrefour, Metro, and Intermarché use Salsify everyday to stand out on the digital shelf.
At Salsify , we strive to embody an equitable, diverse, and inclusive company culture. We are united across countries, levels, tenures, and a host of other dimensions of diversity. We understand that while work is just one aspect of who we are, a truly inclusive culture accounts for the full authenticity of every single human being that works here.
About the Opportunity
Salsify 's value compounds when we sit naturally inside the tools and platforms our customers and prospects already use and trust. This role's job is to make that true, to make Salsify the natural center of the B2B Manufacturing and Distribution ecosystem rather than a standalone decision buyers have to be sold on separately.
Concretely, this role builds, manages, and nurtures the relationships and market presence that turn ecosystem reach into sourced and co-sell ARR.

They won't answer every open question alone, they'll own pieces of it and work with the wider go-to-market team to drive the rest toward resolution, including: which SIs we need relationships with to support aggressive growth, how we build awareness with new ones, which ISVs are worth investing in and how we classify the depth of those relationships, and how we get full value out of partners who aren't already our most active ones.
What Success Looks Like
This is a senior level role, based in the United States, with regular travel to partner offices and industry events. Works in close partnership with Sales, Marketing, Product, Customer Success, and Industry Strategy. The person in this seat is judged on:
The strength and reach of the relationships they hold - with SI and ISV leaders, with industry associations and buying groups, with analysts, and with partner-side sellers who choose to bring Salsify into their deals because they trust this person specifically.
Partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline that those relationships convert into.
How fast partner deals move relative to non-partner deals, because that speed is the proof the trust is real.
Whether partners come back - repeat co-sell motions, not one-off wins.
Market and category credibility - whether conversations with this person leave partners, prospects, and analysts understanding the Industrials PXM category better and understanding why Salsify sits at its center.
What You'll Own
Relationships and ecosystem development
Build and personally hold senior relationships with strategic SI, ISV, and technology partners across the sector.
Identify and recruit the partners we don't have yet, and make the case for why partnering with Salsify is worth their time. This takes real sales instinct, since you're selling the partnership itself before there's any pipeline to point to.
Own the partner's experience of Salsify end to end: recruitment, onboarding, enablement, and the ongoing care that keeps a relationship warm between deals.
Represent Salsify in the rooms that matter - on stage, on webinars, at partner HQs, at industry events, and social side of those events (the dinner, the hallway conversation).
Strategic ownership of the partner ecosystem for B2B Manufacturing and Distribution
Help set the point of view on who we go after and why. The ICP and channel motion for this sector are still being proven out, so this isn't a role that executes someone else's fully-formed strategy, it's a role that helps write it, backed by evidence from the field.
Build the partner classification framework (onboarding stage, integration depth, commercial terms) that lets us tell a strong partner from a merely-signed one.
Pull in the right people to round out a partnership - Product or Services for integration depth, Partner Marketing for co-sponsorship, Sales for the account-level connections, Enablement to get the commercial team fluent in the partnership's value.

A network you're bringing with you, not building from scratch. You should already be known - at least to some degree - among partners, prospects, analysts, and the industry associations or buying groups in this space. That's the single hardest thing to hire for and the thing this role most needs on day one.
5+ years in partner programs, alliance management, channel, or business development, ideally in SaaS, enterprise software, industry roles, or another technology ecosystem.
Genuine comfort in front of a room - stage, webinar, or a partner's own office - and a willingness to travel for it.
Some sales background, or sales instinct, since part of the job is selling partners on partnering with us.
A track record of setting or shaping go-to-market strategy, not just executing a playbook someone else wrote.
Strong program and stakeholder management across regions and functions.
Comfort with ambiguity and test-and-learn.
Working fluency with Salesforce, marketing automation, and reporting tools.
At Salsify , we maintain 3 core principles as part of our Compensation Philosophy :
We pay market rates, which are competitive and equitable
We pay based on performance and proficiency, not tenure
We adjust proactively; when the market moves, we do too
The posted compensation range reflects the base salary for this position. In addition to base salary, some eligible roles may also have a commission plan or a bonus incentive. All Salsify employees receive equity in the form of stock options.

All full-time employees are invited to participate in our Total Rewards plan, which includes health & medical benefits, flexible spending accounts, flexible PTO, and more.

Offers to join Salsify are based on a few criteria, including the scope of the role, the candidate’s work experience, targeted skills, internal equity of the team, and external market data.

We are looking for an experienced Partnership Manager to join our Accountant Partnerships team in France, specifically focused on building and developing relationships with accounting firms and accountant networks.
The core purpose of this role is to turn accounting firms into long-term Alan partners and advocates. You will help them recommend Alan to their clients, improve their day-to-day experience with health insurance and payroll administration, and generate qualified business opportunities for Alan’s Sales teams.
The accountant ecosystem represents a significant growth opportunity for Alan. France has approximately 22,000 accounting firms supporting around 3.5 million companies, and Alan’s existing Accountant Partnership channel has already generated significant ARR through a relatively small number of partners.
The team is now entering a new phase of development. We are hiring new Partnership Manager to help build a scalable, high-performing partner network and contribute to Alan’s ambition to make Accountant Partnerships a strategic growth channel.

s.h: Here is how your key outcomes will look like
s.t:
Build and grow a strong partner network: Identify, prioritise and develop relationships with high-potential accounting firms and networks.
Drive partnerships from discussion to activation: Lead partnership discussions, onboarding and launch, ensuring that Alan creates value for both accountants and their clients.
Activate partners and generate business opportunities: Build engagement plans, support partner enablement and work closely with Sales to turn recommendations into qualified opportunities.
Help scale the Accountant Partnerships model: Manage partner performance, share insights with internal teams and contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, tools and processes.

s.h: ⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?
s.t:
We’re looking for someone who combines strong partnership and commercial skills with the ability to build trusted relationships in a complex and evolving B2B ecosystem.
The ideal candidate will be comfortable managing partnerships from initial contact to activation and long-term development. They should enjoy working autonomously in an environment where there is still a lot to build.

s.h: You may be a great fit at Alan if you have/are
s.t:
5+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, account management or customer success in a B2B environment
Experience managing partnerships throughout the full lifecycle, from prospecting and closing to activation and ongoing relationship management
Experience managing a portfolio of partners, ideally in a fast-growing company
Strong negotiation, communication, presentation and relationship-building skills
A data-oriented mindset, with the ability to track performance and prioritise opportunities
The ability to collaborate effectively with Sales, Marketing, Product, Data and Operations teams
An entrepreneurial mindset, strong ownership and the ability to work autonomously
Full professional fluency in French and professional fluency in English
Experience working directly with accounting firms, payroll providers, HR software or insurance companies would be a strong plus.
We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience with B2B distribution partnerships, where a third party recommends or distributes a solution to its own customers. Experience limited to technology integrations, co-marketing or visibility partnerships would be less relevant for this role.
For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level .
Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Fair rewards . Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.
Flexible office with hybrid setup . Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.
All the tools you need . Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.
Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours . Organize your time as you wish.
Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

Learning & Training opportunities . A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.
Personal growth through coaching : At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture .
Parental leave . Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.
Important note: we hire people not roles.
After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply !
Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

As Senior Partnerships Manager at bunch, you will be a senior individual contributor owning the partnership function across our core markets: the partners who send us clients, and the specialist providers who help us service those mandates end-to-end.
Fund administration is a partnership-driven business . The right referral and channel partners create qualified pipeline at scale. The right provider network ensures we can support fund managers across markets without capability gaps. This role brings both together.
This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role . You will personally build the channel that brings clients in, develop the provider network that lets us keep them, and establish the systems behind the function. It is a revenue-generating role with direct impact on ARR, and it is also serviceability-critical: making sure bunch can support fund mandates in our markets with confidence, quality, and speed.
The near-term mandate is to prove and scale the partnerships motion through direct execution. As the function matures and its impact becomes repeatable, there is potential to shape the future operating model and build a team .

Own the partnership program across bunch’s core markets— UK, Germany, and Luxembourg —keeping a consistent framework while adapting activation to local market dynamics and regulatory realities
Personally identify, sign, and activate referral and channel partners , including fund formation counsel, placement agents, banks, audit advisors, and tax advisors
Convert partner relationships into qualified pipeline and measurable partner-sourced ARR
Structure and maintain relationships with regulated and specialist providers , including depositaries, AML officers, ManCos, auditors, and onboarding, compliance, accounting, and tax specialists
Close capability gaps so bunch can service fund mandates end-to-end across our markets, with particular focus on Luxembourg’s regulated-provider network
Own commercial negotiation, pricing, and scope across partnerships, working closely with the relevant operations owners on delivery
Build the infrastructure behind the channel from day one: tracking partner introductions, conversion to clients, partner-sourced pipeline, revenue, and activation timelines
Partner with Commercial and Marketing on joint go-to-market initiatives , including co-hosted events, co-authored content, and partner-facilitated introductions
Represent bunch at key industry events and forums across our markets; regular travel is expected
Use data and market feedback to recommend when and how the function should expand , including the capabilities and roles a future team may need

s.h: The two pillars of the role
s.t:
Grow the channel
You will personally identify, sign, and activate referral and channel partners that convert into qualified pipeline at scale. You will own the commercial relationship, including negotiation, pricing, activation, and scope expansion. Once a referred client is live, day-to-day delivery sits with the relevant operations owner; your focus stays on growing the relationship and driving more pipeline through it.
Close the capability map
You will identify, structure, and maintain relationships with specialist and regulated providers that allow bunch to service fund mandates end-to-end. These relationships are ongoing and operational by nature; you own them commercially while delivery runs alongside the relevant teams.
What Success Looks Like
Acting as the hands-on owner of partnerships rather than delegating execution
Setting strategy and priorities while also sourcing, negotiating, activating, and expanding partnerships directly
Influencing senior stakeholders across Commercial, Marketing, Operations, Product, and leadership
Creating a repeatable operating model, clear metrics, and evidence of commercial impact
What This Role Does Not Own
Immediate people management: this is not a team-lead role on day one, and there is no expectation to hire before the function’s needs are proven
Day-to-day service delivery: operational delivery sits with the relevant operations owners; you own the commercial partner relationship and help resolve structural issues
All strategic platform partnerships: marquee, leadership-level relationships remain shared with bunch’s leadership team. You may contribute to or increasingly own selected strategic relationships where your expertise and the business need align

5–10 years of relevant experience in partnerships, business development, or a senior client-facing role within fund administration, fund services, fintech, or professional services; depth of ownership matters more than exact tenure
Strong understanding of private markets and how fund managers actually operate
A track record of building something from scratch , such as a partner programme, new market, or commercial channel
Comfortable operating with ambiguity , creating structure as you go, and owning a measurable commercial outcome
A senior operator who remains energised by direct execution : opening doors, running partner conversations, negotiating agreements, activating relationships, and building the underlying process
Commercially sharp: you understand how referral and delivery partnerships work , what makes each valuable, and how to structure agreements that work for both sides
Able to hold credible senior conversations with law firms, depositaries, regulated providers, and professional services firms
Strong cross-functional partner to Sales, Customer Success, Operations, Product, and leadership teams , influencing without relying on formal authority
Organised and systems-oriented, with the ability to build tracking, reporting, and process while moving fast
Fluent in the language of private markets, including fund structures, LP/GP dynamics, and the regulatory environment across the UK and Europe
Familiar with the role of depositaries, ManCos, AML officers, and other regulated or specialist providers in fund operations
Existing relationships in the UK and/or European VC/PE ecosystem —such as law firms, accountancy practices, placement agents, banks, or regulated providers—that give you a running start
Willing and able to travel regularly across bunch’s markets
Interested in the potential to build a team when the business is ready , without seeing immediate people management as a prerequisite for seniority

Customizable benefits package (wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more)
28 days of vacation , plus 2 company days and local public holidays
Remote-flexible hybrid setup , depending on location and role requirements
Up to 4 remote calendar weeks a year
A great tech and work setup
Work with a diverse team of 120+ bunchies from 40+ countries , with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

About Phase2
Our remote first employees join and stay at Phase2 to be a force. In pursuit of digital experience that advances the human experience, you will do your best work, live fully, and succeed as a team.
Phase2 a digital agency passionate about customer experience, grounded in data & insights, and rooted in more than two decades of successful technology delivery. We guide industry-leading companies to what’s next in their digital landscape.
And it all begins with finding the right people who align with our values and passion for impact.

We’re hiring an Account Director to drive consultative growth across a portfolio of clients, leading enterprise-scale digital and AI-enabled transformation initiatives.
At Phase2 , we create custom digital products to solve complex business problems, partnering with clients to build tailored solutions rather than selling SaaS or subscription-based software.
This is a quota-carrying, in-account growth role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, leads with insight, and diagnoses business problems before prescribing solutions.
You’ll challenge assumptions, navigate objections, and build business cases that unlock meaningful investment.
This role demands a consultative selling and strategic mindset. Success requires the ability to sell vision, outcomes, and transformation, often before clients fully understand what they need.
You will operate at the intersection of digital experience, technology modernization, and transformative AI, helping clients move from fragmented initiatives to integrated, high-impact solutions.
This position reports to the SVP, Account Management

On-Target Earnings (OTE): $135,000–$200,000
Commission: $25,000–$50,000 annually at 100% of quota; uncapped commission potential

A consultative seller and portfolio growth strategist.
Thrive in a fast-paced environment where solutions must be shaped in real time.
Ask sharp questions, uncover root problems, and reframe client thinking.
Are comfortable pushing back, handling objections, and navigating complexity.
Can translate digital and AI capabilities into the business outcomes that executives care about.
Know how to sell services, platforms, and transformation.
A hands-on closer who can own the vision, shape the strategy, and execute the deal.

Drive In-Account Pipeline and Revenue Growth
Generate a robust pipeline that leads to closing $5M+ in new revenue within 12 months across an existing portfolio and newly signed clients.
Proactively identify areas of opportunity within accounts, lead the complete sales cycle from discovery and rigorous qualification through to pitch, strategic pricing, proposal, negotiation, and close.
Maintain clean, accurate forecasting and pipeline hygiene in Salesforce.
Shape deal strategy, pricing, and scope for high-value digital and AI engagements.
Navigate objections, procurement hurdles, and ambiguity with confidence.
Sell Digital & AI Solutions
Translate AI and digital capabilities into measurable business impact using value-selling methodologies.
A thought leader who guides clients through practical and transformative AI integration across marketing, content, IT, and digital operations.
Position AI, digital experience, and modernization as business imperatives.
Build compelling value narratives tied to ROI, risk reduction, speed, and competitive advantage.
Translate complex technology concepts into clear executive-level business cases.
Act as a Trusted Client Advisor
Build deep relationships with Senior and C-Suite stakeholders within accounts.
Serve as a point of escalation, balancing client needs with internal delivery realities.
Partner closely with delivery, strategy, and leadership teams to ensure successful outcomes.
Represent Phase2 at industry events and maintain an active, credible thought leadership presence.
Travel to client sites, internal offices, or industry events as needed (typically up to 20%).
Other Ways You’ll Make an Impact
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to shape and deliver solutions that drive measurable value.
Champion client successes internally by ensuring visibility across teams and leadership.
Support marketing in developing case studies and thought leadership, highlighting client impact.
Maintain strong leadership presence within accounts by positioning forward-looking, strategic work that aligns with where the market is headed.
Collaborate with platform and technology partners to identify and pursue co-selling opportunities.
Contribute to a culture of performance, knowledge-sharing, and sales excellence.
What You'll Need
10+ years of consultative digital sales experience within an agency, consultancy, or transformation-led firm, with a strong track record of growing existing client relationships
Success in overseeing client portfolios contributing $5 million+ in revenue annually.
Ability to generate $5M+ in sales, including expansions and renewals, within the assigned portfolio within 12 months.
Strong understanding of digital experience, platforms, and AI-enabled solutions.
Comfort operating in ambiguity and shaping solutions collaboratively with clients.
Experience influencing senior executives through strategic insight, persuasive communication, and effective negotiation.
What Will Immediately Set You Apart
Experience navigating legacy systems, organizational resistance, and competing priorities.
Ability to clearly generate buyer demand and articulate why clients need to act now.
Demonstrated use of AI in your own workflow and client conversations.

s.h: What Would Be Nice to Have
s.t:
Experience in regulated industries (e.g., healthcare, pharma, wellness, financial services).
Familiarity with platforms like Drupal, Acquia, Adobe Experience Cloud, Optimizely, or similar DXPs.
Demonstrated thought leadership (e.g., panels, blog posts, speaking engagements) in AI or digital transformation.
What Success Looks Like
You consistently hit or exceed $5M+ in annual sales
Your pipeline is active, qualified, and forecastable
Clients see you as a strategic partner , not a vendor
You’re shaping client roadmaps and influencing long-term investment decisions
You’re trusted internally to handle the most complex, high-stakes opportunities
What You'll Get
Fully Remote
Work from anywhere with the support of a remote-first team and flexible culture.
Your salary is determined based on experience, education, certifications, skills, and current market conditions.

Full coverage including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability. We also offer supplemental insurance options through Aflac and Transamerica.
Wellness That Rewards You
Our fun and interactive wellness program offers rewards for participation.
Retirement Savings
A 401(k) with a 3% employer contribution–no match required and 100% vested after just 90 days.
Generous Time Off
You’ll start with 16 paid vacation days, 4 personal days, and 1 volunteer day each year. Vacation and personal time increase with your tenure, recognizing your continued contributions.
Paid Parental Leave
We offer up to 12 weeks of fully paid leave for birthing parents and up to 6 weeks of fully paid bonding leave, based on your tenure. This includes support for adoption and foster placement, along with the option to extend time off through additional unpaid leave.

Born from groundbreaking research at Columbia University and Yale University, CertiK is a leading Web3 security company focused on securing blockchain protocols, smart contracts, and decentralized applications through cutting-edge security research, formal verification, and AI-powered technology.

Founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York City, CertiK provides end-to-end security solutions including smart contract audits, penetration testing, on-chain monitoring, incident response, and compliance services for some of the largest projects in the digital asset ecosystem.
Today, CertiK supports thousands of enterprise clients and Web3 projects globally, with a distributed international team spanning North America, Asia, and Europe. The company is backed by leading investors including Coatue, Goldman Sachs, Insight Partners, and Sequoia Capital, and has been recognized by organizations such as the World Economic Forum and CB Insights for its contributions to blockchain security innovation.

Pipeline Generation & Outbound BD: Actively identify, prospect, and engage decision-makers (CTOs, Founders, Head of Web3/Digital Assets) across blockchain protocols, DeFi projects, RWA tokenization platforms, exchanges, and Web2 institutional entrants.
Full Sales Cycle Execution: Drive complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from initial outreach and technical discovery to proposal creation, price negotiation, and contract execution.
Enterprise & Institutional Sales: Engage traditional financial institutions, asset managers, family offices, and tech enterprises seeking institutional-grade security for their Web3 initiatives.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with CertiK’s global security engineering, solutions architecture, delivery, and marketing teams to ensure smooth deal execution and client onboarding.
Account Expansion & Networking: Build long-term relationships with key accounts to drive renewals, audit add-ons, and monitoring subscriptions. Represent CertiK at local industry events, conferences, and ecosystem meetups.

Experience: 2–5 years of successful B2B sales or business development experience in Web3, blockchain security, cybersecurity, SaaS, or institutional fintech.
Domain Knowledge: Strong familiarity with Web3 native ecosystems (EVM chains, Layer 1/Layer 2 protocols, DeFi, tokenomics, smart contract architectures).
Good understanding of Web2 cybersecurity fundamentals (e.g., penetration testing, code review, risk assessments).
Core Languages: Professional working proficiency (written and spoken) in English and Vietnamese for regional collaboration and global client management.
Track Record: Proven ability to meet or exceed quarterly sales quotas through structured outbound outreach and consultative deal closing.
Language & Skills Bonuses (Highly Preferred) Regional Asian Languages (Bonus): Proficiency in additional regional languages—such as Japanese, Korean, or other languages, —is a significant bonus for driving APAC cross-border expansion or local market expansion.
Security & Audit Familiarity: Direct experience selling smart contract audits, penetration tests, or bug bounty services.
Regulatory Context: Understanding of Vietnam’s digital asset licensing landscape is a bonus.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

Additional Information
This role must be performed outside the United States. We are unable to consider candidates who will work from within the U.S.

What Makes Cloudbeds Unique
At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually.

From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges.

Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024, but we're just getting started.

As we scale, our Sales Development team is the front line for identifying and engaging the properties and hospitality groups who will benefit most from our platform.

This is a BDR role with a slight twist: in addition to prospecting, qualifying, and booking demos for our Account Executives, you'll play a direct role in maintaining clean, well-organized property and account data — including capturing accurate account hierarchy (property, brand, chain, group relationships) as part of your day-to-day workflow.
This role is ideal for a self-starter who is comfortable working a structured pipeline, enjoys the details of good data hygiene, and has been testing how AI-powered tools can make prospecting sharper and more efficient.

As a Business Development Representative ( BDR ), you will help drive Cloudbeds’ growth by identifying, engaging, and qualifying independent hotels, boutique properties, and hospitality groups. You will generate qualified pipeline for our Account Executives while helping maintain accurate, well-structured account and property data in Salesforce.

This role is ideal for a motivated self-starter who enjoys outbound prospecting, works well within a structured pipeline, and is curious about using data and AI-powered tools to make prospecting more effective.

s.h: What You Bring to the Team
s.t:
Research, identify, and prioritize target properties and hospitality groups within assigned territories or market segments.
Execute high-quality outbound prospecting across phone, email, LinkedIn, and other channels to generate interest and qualified pipeline.
Qualify inbound leads and marketing-generated demand using Cloudbeds’ established qualification framework.
Book qualified demos and meetings for Account Executives, providing a smooth handoff with complete and relevant prospect context.
Develop a strong understanding of the Cloudbeds platform and tailor your messaging to each prospect’s property type, business needs, and pain points.
Build and manage a clear plan of attack for your territory or target-account list, prioritizing effectively and maintaining a disciplined outreach cadence.
Consistently meet or exceed activity, qualified-meeting, and pipeline-generation targets.
Accurately maintain property, contact, ownership, management, brand, chain, and group information in Salesforce.
Identify and document relationships between individual properties and their parent brands, chains, ownership groups, or management companies.
Flag duplicate, outdated, or incomplete records and follow Cloudbeds’ established data-governance processes.
Partner with GTM Intelligence and Revenue Operations to improve data quality and provide frontline feedback on gaps in account information.
Support prospecting campaigns connected to Cloudbeds Connect, trade shows, webinars, regional events, and other marketing programs.
Execute targeted pre-event outreach and timely post-event follow-up, segmenting prospects based on fit, engagement, and next steps.
Maintain accurate event and campaign records in Salesforce so meetings, pipeline, and campaign ROI can be measured effectively.
Explore how AI-assisted prospecting, enrichment, messaging, and call-intelligence tools can improve outreach quality and productivity.
Share practical feedback and ideas as Cloudbeds continues to develop AI-powered GTM workflows.

s.h: What Sets You Up for Success (required)
s.t:
2+ years of B2B sales or sales development.
Strong interest in developing a career in sales and progressing into a closing role.
Confidence conducting cold outreach and handling initial prospect objections.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to personalize messaging rather than rely solely on generic scripts.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage a high-volume pipeline, competing priorities, and time-sensitive campaigns.
A disciplined, detail-oriented approach to CRM management and account-data accuracy.
A self-starter mentality, with the ability to build and execute a personal plan of attack without heavy day-to-day oversight.
Motivation to perform against clear activity and pipeline goals.
Familiarity with Salesforce and Salesloft or a comparable sales-engagement platform.
Curiosity about AI tools and how they can improve prospecting, research, and sales effectiveness.

Experience selling into or working within the hospitality or lodging industry.
Familiarity with property-management systems or other hospitality technology.
Experience working with parent-child account hierarchies or complex account structures in a CRM.
Experience with Clay, Apollo, or other AI-powered enrichment and prospecting tools.
Experience supporting event-based prospecting, field-marketing campaigns, or structured lead-nurture programs.
Multilingual capabilities.

Aptos is a people-first blockchain on a mission to help billions of people achieve universal and fair access to decentralized assets in a safe and scalable way.
Founded by some of the original creators and maintainers that researched, designed, and built the Diem blockchain to serve this purpose, we have dedicated several years toward this mission. Aptos (Ohlone for "The People") encompasses our mission and ethos for why we build.
Shelby is a high-performance object storage platform with a global namespace, purpose-built for AI and large-scale, data-intensive workloads. It enables organizations to store data once and access it from anywhere—bringing data closer to compute while delivering cloud-grade performance at significantly lower cost.
As AI infrastructure becomes increasingly distributed, organizations need data platforms that support training, inference, and global collaboration without complex or expensive data replication. Shelby’s “write once, read anywhere” architecture simplifies global data movement across regions, teams, and compute environments.
Designed for secure, high-throughput, read-optimized access patterns, Shelby plays a critical role across the AI data lifecycle—from data acquisition to model training to inference. The platform can also be deployed within select datacenters, enabling flexible, hybrid infrastructure strategies.
Shelby is built by a team with deep experience in large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems, and production-grade platforms.

We’re hiring a Head of Enterprise GTM to define and lead Shelby’s enterprise go-to-market motion from the ground up.
This is a 0→1 role for someone who has taken complex AI, data, or cloud platforms and turned them into real enterprise adoption and revenue.
